english: You sanctify your city of Pāṭaliputra and your father Deśaṭa by your virtue, so approach, that I may devour you.” When Rūpavatī heard that, she came up quickly and said: “Eat me, for if my husband is eaten, what will become of me?” The Rākṣasa said: “You can live on alms.” She replied: “Who, noble sir, will give alms to me who am a woman?” The Rākṣasa said: “If anyone refuses to give you alms when asked to do so, his head shall split in a hundred pieces.”[17] Then she said: “This being so, give me my husband by way of alms.” And as the Rākṣasa would not give him, his head at once split asunder, and he died.
